state:
Goal `core-process-and-4-more`. `Core\Process`, `Core\Process\Handle`, `Core\Process\Result` and `Core\Program` are green. `Core\Queue`, `Core\Queue\Id` and `Core\Queue\Stats` have class cards (`QUEUE_CARD`, `ID_CARD`, `STATS_CARD` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/queue.rs`), are out of `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD`, and every member card of the three is in the plain voice. `Core\Queue::push` and `Core\Queue::status` have all their feature proofs, with perf recorded. Each of the six `Core\Queue` members has a Rust `covers:` marker in `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/queue_sqlite.rs`.

`cancel`, `delete`, `purge` and `stats` still owe about, three examples, an attack and a bench each (`bun nv proofs --verify --group 'Core\Queue'`). `Core\Queue\Stats`'s five members are credited to `stats`'s proofs or owe their own; check with `bun nv proofs --verify --group 'Core\Queue\Stats'` first.

The `status` attack found a fatal: a `state` cell the program overwrote with text ended the request. It now throws an `IOError`, pinned by `tests/conformance/core/queue-status-throws-for-a-state-that-is-not-a-number.nvst`.

The shape every `Core\Queue` proof uses (an in-memory SQLite block, tables created by the program) is a playbook bullet under *Writing a test case*. Copy `docs/examples/core/Queue/status/nvs.toml` into each new member directory, and into `tests/hostile/core/Queue/<member>/`. The benches share `benches/members/core/Queue/nvs.toml`. `bun nv try` does not read a `--FILE nvs.toml--` section, so a queue `.nvst` runs only under `bun nv verify`.

items.text: **`Core\Queue::cancel` and `Core\Queue::delete`** — about, three examples, attack and bench each; the Rust markers exist. `delete` needs `[capabilities.queue] purge` (or however the grant is written; read the `DELETE_DOC` card and the grant check) in its `nvs.toml`. `rule:testing/feature-proofs`. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/queue.rs:2289` `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/queue.rs:2345`

**`Core\Queue::stats` and `Core\Queue::purge`** — the same proofs. The `stats` attack should overwrite `attempts` with text, to test whether the counter read at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/queue.rs:5050` is still a `Fault::fatal` a program can reach. `rule:testing/feature-proofs`. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/queue.rs:2316` `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/queue.rs:2379`

**`Core\Queue\Stats`'s five members** — whatever `bun nv proofs --verify --group 'Core\Queue\Stats'` still names after the item above. `rule:testing/feature-proofs`. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/queue.rs:2548`

backlog: `push` reads its new row's `id` with a `Fault::fatal` for a non-integer (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/queue.rs:3817`); a program cannot write that cell before the insert, so it is likely unreachable. Not checked. Owner: `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/queue.rs`'s module doc if it proves reachable.
